method: Two new persistent judge contexts, independent from authorship; same literal bodies, decisive source excerpts, frozen criteria and private cases; no judge tools or product execution.
review_identity: J1 fidelity/authority and J2 completeness/utility; both apply all applicable criteria. Real handles and original decisions retained privately. No claim of model diversity or OS-enforced context isolation.

resolved_findings: Reading method/coverage supplied explicitly, distinct from byte identity.
Applicable inherited criteria supplied in full; no extension to runtime/global acceptance.

limits: Acceptance is documentary and local to the exact listed body.
Other source bodies are authored, not accepted by extrapolation.
No global PASS. Private original judgments are not published here.
